verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online's API access relies on standard OAuth 2.0 (token management/refresh, client libraries) and includes some role/permission management for users, which could underpin least-privilege access, but there is no explicit documentation of issuing scoped, agent-specific API credentials or granular OAuth scopes tailored for AI-agent use cases. missing for 10: explicit scope/permission granularity documentation for API tokens, agent-specific credential issuance workflow, and confirmation that the official MCP server supports scoped/least-privilege tokens rather than full-account OAuth access.
